zh: 边长为 L 的正方形需要 L² 个格子，而总面积最多是 m+4n，所以 L 不会超过 m+4n 的整数平方根。
偶数边长可以用 2×2 砖铺满，大砖不够就用小砖补，只要总面积够即可。奇数边长时最多只能放 floor(L/2) 的平方块大砖，至少剩下一行一列共 2L−1 个格子只能用小砖。
取 L 为 m+4n 的整数平方根（用整数方法求或求后校正，避免浮点误差，并使用 64 位整数）。若 L 是奇数且 m 小于 2L−1，就把 L 减 1；此时 L 是偶数且面积更小，必然可行。输出 L。
en: A square of side L needs L² cells and the total area is at most m+4n, so L cannot exceed the integer square root of m+4n.

An even side can be tiled by 2×2 tiles, with unit tiles filling in when large tiles run out, so only the total area matters. For an odd side at most floor(L/2) squared large tiles fit, and the remaining row and column of 2L−1 cells can only take unit tiles.

Let L be the integer square root of m+4n (compute it with integers, or correct a floating-point estimate, using 64-bit integers). If L is odd and m is less than 2L−1, decrease L by 1; the new L is even with a smaller area, so it is always feasible. Print L.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First take the square root L of the total area. An even side length is limited only by the total area; an odd L needs at least 2L−1 unit tiles, and if there are not enough, drop to L−1.

## Correctness

A square of side L holds at most floor(L/2)² large tiles, and the remaining cells can be filled with unit tiles. For an even L, if there are not enough large tiles, the total-area constraint guarantees enough unit tiles to fill in; for an odd L, besides the total area, the 2L−1 border cells that the largest array of large tiles cannot cover must also be filled. When L is not feasible, L−1 is even with a smaller area, so it is necessarily feasible and optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(log(m+4n)) for the integer square root, space O(1).
